question_html: What are Accounting Standards primarily designed to ensure in financial reporting?

options.A: Transparency, consistency, comparability, adequacy, and reliability
options.B: Maximum tax deduction and profit inflation
options.C: Secrecy of corporate operations from investors
options.D: Strict adherence to physical inventory valuation only

answer_html: Answer: (A) Accounting standards ensure transparency, consistency, comparability, adequacy, and reliability of financial reporting[cite: 54].
topic_text: Introduction of Accounting Standards

question_html: Which body issues Accounting Standards for non-corporate entities in India?

options.A: Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)
options.C: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)

answer_html: Answer: (A) Accounting Standards for non-corporate entities in India are issued by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India[cite: 54].
topic_text: Process of Formulation of Accounting Standards

question_html: Accounting standards deal with how many core areas of accounting transactions?

options.A: Four areas: recognition, measurement, presentation, and disclosure
options.C: Three areas: asset, liability, and capital
options.D: Five areas: planning, organizing, staffing, directing, and controlling

answer_html: Answer: (A) Accounting standards deal with recognition, measurement, presentation, and disclosure of transactions and events[cite: 54].
topic_text: Introduction of Accounting Standards

question_html: What is the primary effect of accounting standards on alternative accounting treatments?

options.A: Standardisation and reduction of variations within bounds of rationality
options.B: Total prohibition of all alternative methods except one rigid rule

answer_html: Answer: (A) Standards standardise alternative accounting treatments and reduce variations within rationality[cite: 54].
topic_text: Objectives of Accounting Standards

question_html: Why is standardization of accounting principles considered essential?

options.A: To prevent financial statements from being misleading, tendentious, and distorted
options.B: To reduce the number of chartered accountants needed
options.C: To eliminate the need for corporate income tax filing
options.D: To mandate uniform software usage across all businesses

answer_html: Answer: (A) Standardization ensures statements are not misleading, tendentious, or distorted[cite: 54].
topic_text: Introduction of Accounting Standards

question_html: Which of the following is an objective of setting Accounting Standards?

options.A: Harmonisation of diverse accounting policies and practices
options.B: Maximization of short-term stock market volatility
options.C: Reduction of corporate transparency to protect management secrets
options.D: Elimination of financial statements for small businesses

answer_html: Answer: (A) The objective is harmonisation of diverse accounting policies and practices[cite: 54].
topic_text: Objectives of Accounting Standards

question_html: How do accounting standards help external investors and stakeholders?

options.A: By providing an insight into financial statements to facilitate informed and prudent business decisions
options.B: By guaranteeing fixed dividend returns on equity
options.D: By providing insider trading tips legally

answer_html: Answer: (A) Standards help stakeholders get insight into financial statements to take informed business decisions[cite: 54].
topic_text: Introduction of Accounting Standards

question_html: Which of the following best describes the scope limitation of Accounting Standards?

options.A: Accounting standards cannot override the statute
options.B: Accounting standards supersede all acts of Parliament
options.C: Accounting standards apply only to government departments
options.D: Accounting standards have legal supremacy over the Constitution

answer_html: Answer: (A) Accounting standards cannot override the statute and must be framed within prevailing laws[cite: 54].
topic_text: Benefits and Limitations of Accounting Standards

question_html: What is a recognized limitation regarding the choice of accounting treatments?

options.A: Difficulties in making a choice between different alternative treatments each having valid arguments

answer_html: Answer: (A) A limitation is the difficulty in choosing between alternative treatments that each have valid arguments[cite: 54].
topic_text: Benefits and Limitations of Accounting Standards

question_html: Do accounting standards require disclosures beyond statutory laws?

options.A: Yes, standards may call for disclosure beyond that required by law in important areas
options.B: No, statutory law is the absolute ceiling for all disclosures
options.C: Only if approved by the Prime Minister's office
options.D: Never, disclosures are strictly limited to the Companies Act text

answer_html: Answer: (A) Standards may call for disclosure beyond statutory requirements where important information is needed[cite: 54].
topic_text: Benefits and Limitations of Accounting Standards
